---
name: first-issue-pack
description: Create implementation-ready starter issues for VenturaGame from the approved playable MVP and Beta gates. Use when maintainers need small independent tasks that move the scaffold toward a reproducible prototype. Do not use when requirements are undefined or the issue would duplicate active work.
---

# First issue pack

- Read the current game-loop scope and repository state first.
- Create one verifiable outcome per issue.
- Include a prompt or expected playable behavior in acceptance criteria when relevant.
- Separate generator core runtime tests examples and export work when independent.
- Keep each issue suitable for one focused pull request.
- Mark dependencies explicitly and avoid speculative engine support.
